audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Heimerdinger Levels 1-3 and then hedged everything from Levels 4-5 onward, including the two-item stage that the page's own whys[6] and late paragraph say Ryze owns.
audit.why: Packet chart and the audited Heimerdinger-side mirror both read Skill / Heimerdinger x5 / Ryze. The packet's flagged defect is about the stored chart being self-contradictory, not about the packet chart.
audit.corrected: Skill / Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Ryze with ratings, matched pairs across both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 4-5, Level 6 and First item were all scored even and their whys described a Ryze who duels and disengages.
audit.why: Heimerdinger has no engage to Phase-Rush away from — he out-ranges Ryze with Hextech Micro-Rockets at 1325 to Overload's 1000 and holds turret coverage over the wave. Realm Warp (180/160/140s) is a delayed group portal, and his first item lands before Seraph's. Ryze's only stage is two items.
audit.corrected: Those three stages rewritten as Heimerdinger's, with the range gap and turret coverage as the reasons.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never mentions that turrets body-block Ryze's abilities, says he must walk to melee range to set up Flux, and gives CH-2 Grenade a 12-second cooldown.
audit.why: Overload and Spell Flux hit the FIRST enemy struck, so a deployed turret between you and Heimerdinger eats the cast entirely — that is the defining interaction of this lane and it was absent. Spell Flux is a 615-range cast and Overload 1000, so no melee approach exists. CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is 11 seconds flat at every rank, at 970 range; Rune Prison is 615 on 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s, so landing it means walking inside both his grenade and his rockets.
audit.corrected: Turret body-block stated, real ranges used instead of 'melee range', and the grenade's flat 11s given.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text schedules every trade around a '12-second cooldown'.
audit.why: The grenade is 11 seconds at all five ranks — it never changes, which is itself useful to say.
suspectNames flagged 'Evolution Turret' and 'Evolution Turrets' — false positives against the full name H-28 G Evolution Turret, which the page already writes correctly.

edits.before: Phase Rush turns his engage into your trade window — combo, proc the speed, and walk away untouched.
edits.after: Turrets and 1325-range rockets chip you all wave; your 1000-range Q cannot answer that trade.

edits.before: Realm Warp opens flanks and escapes, and your EQ DPS now duels most tops on their cooldown gaps.
edits.after: Realm Warp is macro only — he still holds the stun and full turret coverage over the wave.

edits.before: Rod of Ages ends the HP problem — your short trades become favourable on raw math.
edits.after: His first item lands before your Seraph's — turret DPS and poke range grow first.

edits.before: The stun makes his turret nest lethal — dodge it before diving. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: CH-2 Grenade is 11 seconds at every rank and makes the nest lethal — enter only inside its downtime.

edits.before: Track Heimerdinger’s CH-2 Grenade (Stun): The stun makes his turret nest lethal — dodge it before diving. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Track CH-2 Grenade (11s at every rank): turrets body-block your Q and E, so cast from an angle where no turret sits in the line.

edits.before: E-Flux the minion next to him, W root through the wave, Q twice as Phase Rush procs, and walk out of his answer with the speed boost.
edits.after: E-Flux from an angle where no turret blocks the line, W root through the wave, Q twice as Phase Rush procs, and walk out on the speed.

edits.before: CH-2 Grenade stun is the matchup-defining threat — one stun inside his turret nest is a kill, so every trade attempt must be scheduled around its 12-second cooldown.
edits.after: CH-2 Grenade stun is the matchup-defining threat — one stun inside his turret nest is a kill, so schedule every trade around its 11-second cooldown, which never shortens.

edits.before: Deny your melee-range Flux-chain pattern with W Hextech Micro-Rockets poke so you can never safely set up E-Q-W cycling
edits.after: Out-range you with Hextech Micro-Rockets, 1325 to your Overload's 1000, so you never safely set up an E-Q-W cycle

edits.before: At level 1 Ryze has only Q and must walk to melee range to set up Flux chains — Heimerdinger drops his first H-28G Evolution Turret on the wave and forces you to CS from the back of the minion line or eat turret plus auto poke. Play purely for Manaflow Band stacks and Tear procs; no trades, no aggression. At level 2 your W root exists but spending it to engage into a turret nest is how you die to the stun follow-up — hold it as an escape tool and keep last-hitting at max Q distance. By level 3 your combo loop is online but Heimerdinger's E stun still hard-denies any walk-up, so only attempt E-Q-W rotations in the brief window after CH-2 Grenade misses or comes off cooldown; never start a trade when the stun is available.
edits.after: At level 1 Ryze has only Q and every cast stops on the first thing it hits — Heimerdinger drops his first H-28 G Evolution Turret on the wave, so a turret in the line eats the Q meant for him. Play purely for Manaflow Band stacks and Tear procs; no trades, no aggression. At level 2 your W root exists but it is a 615-range cast, so using it to engage a turret nest is how you die to the stun follow-up — hold it as an escape and last-hit at max Q distance. By level 3 your loop is online but his grenade is 11 seconds at every rank and hard-denies any walk-up, so only attempt E-Q-W in the window after it misses or expires; never start a trade while the stun is up.

notes: The decisive interaction was missing entirely: Overload and Spell Flux hit the first enemy struck, so Heimerdinger's deployed turrets body-block them — that is why walking up 'to melee range' (which the page recommended, and which is wrong anyway at 615/1000 range) fails here. Also corrected the grenade's cooldown from 12s to its true flat 11s at all ranks. Chart aligned to the packet and the audited mirror.
